name: Car Seat
description: Guidelines for traveling with car seat in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: FAA-approved infant car seats are allowed in the cabin if you purchased a seat for the child. Can also be checked at the gate.

checkedBag.reason: Car seats are checked for free by almost all airlines.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring car seat on a plane?

travelTips: FAA-approved infant car seats are allowed in the cabin if you purchased a seat for the child. Can also be checked at the gate.

faq.question: Is car seat allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Car Seat is allowed in carry-on luggage. FAA-approved infant car seats are allowed in the cabin if you purchased a seat for the child. Can also be checked at the gate.

faq.question: Can you pack car seat in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Car Seat is allowed in checked bags. Car seats are checked for free by almost all airlines.
